decisions.what: P1 research roster empty: no scout, reference-design, interface or power researcher
decisions.why: trivially powered (5 V in, one LED branch at ~5 mA); a header, an LED, a resistor and a cap need no research

decisions.what: designing under coverage gap: block:B3 led-indicator (no coverage checklist exists for this topology); research not launched
decisions.why: a single LED + series resistor at 4.3 mA from 5 V is textbook; a research pass would build a checklist for a block with no layout risk. Presented at H1 for the person to overrule

decisions.what: D1 KT-0603G (C12624, Extended, Vf 3.1 V listing value); R1 470R (C23179) not 680R
decisions.why: brief asks for an 0603 green LED and there is no Basic one; at Vf 3.1 V 680R gives 2.4-2.8 mA, below the 3 mA floor, 470R gives 3.5-4.6 mA. Vf is the LCSC listing, the datasheet would not download

decisions.what: hand edit: widened the F.CrtYd of C0603, R0603, LED0603-RD from +-0.80x+-0.40 to +-1.40x+-0.70 mm
decisions.why: the EasyEDA courtyards were the body outline and did not enclose the pads (pads reach +-1.15 x +-0.45); IPC courtyard = pads + 0.25 mm, so placement legality and DRC courtyard checks are not lenient

decisions.what: fp_verify and lib_pin_types not run; D1 cathode = pad 1 from symbol K pin + silk chamfer, not datasheet
decisions.why: no IC on the board, so no datasheet extractions to diff against; the KT-0603G datasheet PDF would not download
